description: Contextium's PreToolUse guards in the shape Claude Code, Codex and Grok Build read (the matchers name Grok's own tool names too). install.sh fills in __WORKBENCH__ and adds .agents/user-hooks.json to this installed copy; ~/.codex/hooks.json and ~/.grok/hooks/contextium.json link to it and ~/.claude/settings.json has it merged in. The leading `: contextium;` marks the entries a re-run replaces.

hooks.command: : contextium; d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)}"; h="$d/.agents/hooks/check-host-infra-safety.sh"; [ -f "$h" ] || h="__WORKBENCH__/.agents/hooks/check-host-infra-safety.sh"; [ -f "$h" ] || exit 0; exec bash "$h"

: contextium; d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)}"; h="$d/.agents/hooks/check-shared-checkout-write.sh"; [ -f "$h" ] || h="__WORKBENCH__/.agents/hooks/check-shared-checkout-write.sh"; [ -f "$h" ] || exit 0; exec bash "$h"

: contextium; d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)}"; h="$d/.agents/hooks/check-shared-checkout-write.sh"; [ -f "$h" ] || h="__WORKBENCH__/.agents/hooks/check-shared-checkout-write.sh"; [ -f "$h" ] || exit 0; exec bash "$h"
